lines.say: Stop sending 'Your order is confirmed!' I ask one question instead.
lines.show: Stop sending 'Your order is confirmed!' Ask 1 question.

lines.say: For example, four zero COD orders. Nobody replied. They refused the parcels.
That message asks nothing. So I just tell Claude.
lines.show: It asks nothing. Just tell Claude.

lines.say: Step one, you paste my kit, plus name, product, total and date.
lines.show: Step 1: paste the kit + order details.

lines.say: Step two, they reply one to confirm, two to change address, three to cancel.
Step three. No reply in a day? You call, or you hold it.
lines.show: Step 3: no reply in a day? Call or hold.

lines.say: A cancel is good news, you lose nothing. A refusal means you pay shipping twice.
lines.show: Cancels: ₹0 before dispatch. Refusals: shipping twice.

lines.say: The catch: paid WhatsApp tools might charge you. The free app won't.
lines.show: Catch: Interakt or Wati may charge. Free app won't.

lines.say: Save this. Comment RTO below and I'll send you the free kit.
